mission.title: Kodiak Seep · ROV Dive 02
mission.note: Original Dive02 KML and ROV ancillary ZIP were downloaded and SHA-256 hashed by an Evercraft GitHub Actions audit. The KML is untimed; the ancillary ZIP contains a 1Hz ROV CSV with 26,092 rows. 300 records overlap the NCEI video UTC window, but instrument position quality, vertical datum and frame-level sync remain UNVERIFIED. No certified reconstruction.

entries.name: ROV HD camera segment · 18:30 UTC
entries.verified_metadata: NCEI identifies a 299-second video segment recorded 2023-08-25T18:30:00Z to 18:34:59Z. H.264 low-resolution MP4 download is listed.
entries.rights: NOAA Ocean Exploration identifies portal video as public domain; credit NOAA Ocean Exploration and cite the specific dataset

entries.name: Dive 02 track · KML
entries.verified_metadata: Original 79,769-byte KML fetched and hashed. Contains one LineString with 1,963 coordinate tokens and zero embedded timestamps. It cannot by itself produce a timed underwater replay.
entries.rights: NOAA archive; review record-specific credit and use constraints before redistribution

entries.name: Dive 02 ROV ancillary data
entries.verified_metadata: Original 15,727,951-byte ZIP fetched and hashed, with seven entries. Includes EX2306_DIVE02_RovTrack1Hz.csv: 26,092 timestamps; 25,518 rows with valid lat/lon and 25,615 numeric negative depths. 300/300 rows in the published video UTC window have both depth and position. Position instrument and depth datum remain unverified.
entries.rights: NOAA archive; review archive record metadata and provenance before redistribution

entries.name: Dive 02 ROV CTD / sensor data
entries.verified_metadata: NOAA expedition landing page lists a DIVE02 ROV CTD/sensor ZIP (53.4 MB); no validated underwater XY or video alignment is assumed.
entries.rights: NOAA archive; review record-specific terms and field definitions

entries.name: NCEI bathymetry archive
entries.verified_metadata: NOAA provides grid extraction, multibeam datasets and bathymetry viewers. This listing is a discovery resource, not a matched EX2306_DIVE02 survey.
entries.rights: Check original dataset's attribution, datum, resolution and usage terms

entries.name: NOAA photogrammetry collection
entries.verified_metadata: NOAA showcases underwater 3D site models including shipwrecks. Many are partner-hosted; downloadable model rights and coordinates were not established.
entries.rights: VIEW-ONLY RESEARCH until individual model ownership, download rights and permission to redistribute are verified

entries.name: GEBCO 2026 global terrain
entries.verified_metadata: Global 15 arc-second bathymetry grid with TID source-method classifications; datasets contain measured and modeled/interpolated depths. It is not a survey of EX2306_DIVE02.
entries.rights: GEBCO_2026 grid terms permit commercial reuse with source acknowledgment and disclaimers; not for navigation or safety decisions

entries.name: NOAA BlueTopo · U.S. bathymetry
entries.verified_metadata: NOAA Coast Survey compilation provides elevation, uncertainty and source-contributor layers. Coverage and metadata vary; not tied to EX2306_DIVE02.
entries.rights: NOAA BlueTopo product is U.S. public domain; inspect contributor source restrictions, coverage flags and attribution before redistribution
